packageRules.description: Everything that never reaches the release: devDependencies and GitHub Actions. One weekly PR typed chore, which the release tool ignores, so merging it cuts no release.

Root npm dependencies ship in the published package, so a bump only reaches users through a release: release-please cuts one for fix. Own weekly PR, so a tooling bump never rides along. devDependencies, the docs site and GitHub Actions stay chore.
